purpose: Independent anonymous common-cause quality review, not self-claim adoption.

required_sections.identity: Original input packet seal and reviewer independence/readset.
required_sections.coverage: For initial, A-final and B-final, account public/private native/image/source obligations; group native original strict outcomes but retain all required U and gaps.
required_sections.initial_causes: Confirmed natural initial common causes, each with category business/visual/accessibility/testability, exact requirement IDs, source/native/image proof and confidence. No row-count multiplication.
required_sections.final_disposition: For each initial cause, per-arm repaired/residual/unresolved, with current-source evidence; confirm all new regression causes separately.
required_sections.alerts: Classify original failed product alerts as TP/FP/unresolved, distinguishing provider/host/oracle/integration failure. A strict F alone is not product truth.
required_sections.source_actuals: Actual-only decisions for independent mandatory source claims; expected/unit stay from independent contract. No computed-style claim from source.
required_sections.visual_actuals: Actual Boolean/null with rationale and exact original snapshot indices per generated catalog; original PNGs, not stitched seams, support image findings.
required_sections.delivery: All mandatory configured public/hidden current-source evidence plus independent quality closed, no confirmed residual/regression or unresolved mandatory evidence. CLI success alone insufficient.
required_sections.limits: No physical touch/OS tree/unmeasured computed-style or human-gold claim; reviewer disagreement remains explicit.

barrier: Start independent final grading only after both final source/self-evidence cohorts seal; reveal mapping only after both reviewer outputs and common-cause matching seal.
